text:
sam: Quick heads-up — customer A hit the rerank 'softcap' today and were surprised that the console marked the request as 'soft-throttled' but we still fanned out to fallback models (lower perf). Link: https://example.com/issue/123
riya: Ugh. Is softcap supposed to change routing? My understanding: softcap should only signal non-enforced budget pressure and not force model fallback unless hardcap. We may be conflating quota UI vs runtime policy.
cheng: Current runtime policy: if tenant hits softcap threshold we set best-effort routing_policy=degraded which prefers cheaper variants. It's by design to keep tail latency.
mike: Can we add a clear console indicator 'routing changed to degraded' and a hover explaining fallback conditions? Customers see 'softcap' but not that model selection changed.
sam: Also the telemetry doesn't show which model variant served each candidate, only aggregate counts. We need per-request model_affinity tag in logs for audit.
deploy-bot: deploy rwd/console/softcap-ux v2 -> success (build 339)
riya: Proposal: separate 'quota signals' from 'routing actions' in console. UI line 1: quota state (ok/soft/hard). Line 2: routing effect (none/soft-fallback/hard-throttle). Add a diff link to the rollout UX.
cheng: Implementation notes: runtime already emits 'routing_action' in trace; we just need to surface it to console and include model_variant in response envelope. Example response snippet to add:
```
{
  "results": [{"candidate_id": "c1", "score": 0.87, "model": "rwd-small-quant"}, ...],
  "routing_action": "soft_fallback"
}
```
mike: That JSON is fine. Concern: adding model into envelope increases payload size. Maybe make it opt-in via ?debug=true or per-tenant flag.
sam: Opt-in makes sense but we should at least emit telemetry with model variant per candidate (not necessarily surface on API by default). Console can show sampled traces by default.
riya: Agree. For the dashboard, add a 'routing impact' chart: % requests with soft_fallback and histogram of candidate model variants.
cheng: Also adjust quota math: softcap shouldn't decrement fanout budgets; soft_fallback should be activated only when latency SLOs at risk. Current rule is purely budget-based.
mike: So action items:
- cheng: emit model_variant in runtime traces and add routing_action tag (ETA 2d)
- riya: mock console UI strings and hover copy (ETA 3d)
- sam: update docs with semantics and examples (eta 1d)
- me (mike): research compact encoding for model tags so payload impact minimal
sarah: tiny note: add unit test for rerank behavior when softcap + high sequence length — we saw a regression last week.
riya: I'll coordinate with QA. @cheng any objections to the change in fallback predicate (budget->latency aware)?
cheng: No objections. We need an ops flag to toggle (default current), rollout can be gradual.
sam: Great. Let's reconvene after PRs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
